name: clrouter
description: Routes each prompt to the model and effort that fit its work, and runs dev tasks through a cascade where the cheapest model codes against locked acceptance tests.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: pop up before switching; auto: switch silently; suggest: only say which model fits; off: do nothing.

judge.title: Judge
judge.description: heuristic: keywords only, free and instant; hybrid: ask the small fast model when the keywords are unsure; model: always ask it.

effort.title: Effort
effort.description: auto: set each prompt's effort to fit its work (low for answers, medium for code, high for deep work, never max); off: leave effort as you set it.
